jobs.description:
HealthRIGHT 360 gives hope, builds health, and changes lives for people in need by providing comprehensive, integrated, compassionate care that includes primary medical care, mental health services, and substance use disorder treatment.
  
This is a union\-eligible position.
  
  

**The required shift for this position is:**  

CalAIM, a Department of Health Care Services (DHCS) initiative, aims to improve Medi\-Cal recipients' quality of life and health outcomes through system reforms. It introduces Enhanced Care Management (ECM), a statewide Medi\-Cal Managed Care Plan (MCP), that offers person\-centered, community\-based highest care management tier within the Medi\-Cal MCP Population Health Management continuum. Participating members are assigned a Care Manager who will meet them wherever they are: on the street, in a shelter, in their provider’s office, or at home to coordinate their health\-related care and services, ensuring holistic approach to their well\-being. In addition, ECM offers community\-based services to address health\-related social needs to help members live healthier lives and avoid more costly levels of care. Some examples include support to secure and maintain housing, access to medically tailored meals for short\-term recovery, and various other community\-based services.
  
  

The Care Manager I facilitates care by connecting clients with suitable services to meet their needs, including physical and mental health, substance use issues, employment (both residential and outpatient), legal concerns, housing, community resources, and aftercare. This in\-person and field\-based role involves working directly with members in diverse settings such as their homes, homeless encampments, service provider locations, and other areas requiring outreach, therefore, reliable transportation is required.
  
  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  

Enrollment and Engagement
  
* Identify eligible individuals from various locations for enrollment into ECM.
* Use multiple strategies for engagement (in\-person meetings, mail, email, texts, telephone, community outreach).


Client Care Activities
  
* Organize client care activities according to Managed Care Plan (MCP) requirements.
* Share information with the client’s multi\-disciplinary care team.
* Implement activities identified in the MCP.
* Provide support to engage clients in their treatment including medication review, appointment scheduling, transportation coordination, and addressing barriers to engagement.
* Assist with intake by completing required assessments.
* Connect clients to benefits, healthcare services, employment, housing, and community resources.
* Monitor client’s progress toward achieving treatment plan goals and provide treatment plan input.


Care Coordination
  
* Maintain regular contact with all providers involved in the client’s care team.
* Ensure continuous and integrated care among all service providers.
* Refer and follow up with primary care, mental health, substance use disorder treatment, and necessary community\-based services.
* Collaborate with clients and their families for community reintegration.
* Collaborate with outside agencies to obtain needed community resources (housing, sober livings, substance abuse recovery agencies, medical facilities, employment/education agencies, DPSS, DMV or other needed resources).
* Communicate collaboratively with all members of the behavioral health team.


Field\-Based Responsibilities
  
* Meet ECM clients at their physical locations and cater to their individual needs.
* Conduct care management activities in locations most attainable and desirable for clients.
* Have access to office space for care management activities and attend required training and meetings as needed.
* Submit mileage for field\-based care management activities for reimbursement.


Administrative Duties
  
* Write and complete all progress notes within 24 hours of service delivery.
* Write client progress letters and court reports.
* Actively participate in assigned Group Supervision, agency, and team meetings.
* Participate in training opportunities and complete assigned training in a timely manner.


QUALIFICATIONS
  
  

Education, Certification, or Licensure
  
* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Valid First Aid and CPR certification or ability to obtain within 30 days of hire.
* Valid California driver’s license and access to registered and insured transportation.


Experience
  
* 2 years of care management experience.
* Experience working with clients experiencing acute withdrawal from substances.


Desired
  
* Experience working with the criminal justice population preferred.
* Experience working with Medi\-Cal, Medi\-Care, and private medical insurance plans preferred.
* Experience providing trauma\-informed services preferred.

Driving Frequently

The Program Manager plays a key role in managing the K12 School Playbook process, analyzing implementation and performance information, identifying trends and effective practices across schools, and supporting the development and adoption of scalable academic solutions. jobs.title: Sales Planning, Insights, and Enablement Analyst
jobs.description:
The Duckhorn Portfolio is North America’s premier luxury wine company. We were established in 1976 by Dan and Margaret Duckhorn. Today, our portfolio features some of North America’s most revered wineries, including Duckhorn Vineyards, Decoy, Goldeneye, Calera, Kosta Browne, Greenwing, and Sonoma\-Cutrer.


The Sales Planning, Insights, and Enablement Analyst will work at the intersection of data, sales strategy, and customer planning to identify insights, support integrated business planning, and market execution. Responsibilities include turning raw data into clear category and customer recommendations, building tools for sales and distributors, building selling stories, running post promo analysis, and building trackers that ensure we execute distribution and programming commitments. This role is a catalyst for AI adoption in the sales organization as well.

**What we will ask you to do:**

* Provide recurring reporting builds and maintain scorecards and dashboards that are accurate, consistent, and delivered on time.
* Serve as the go\-to analyst for whitespace identification, PODs, accounts sold and account targeting, translating market data into prioritized, actionable target lists for field teams.
* Deliver monthly and quarterly business review packages that give sales leadership a clear, complete picture of performance versus plan – with your own synthesized commentary on what the data means.
* Support the annual planning cycle with clean data, structured templates, and territory/account\-level analysis that meaningfully shapes resource allocation decisions.
* Identify and communicate process or reporting improvements that reduce manual effort and improve data quality, including AI automation recommendations.
* Analyze sales performance account trends, and market data across channels to identify growth opportunities, risks, and execution gaps.
* Translate data from multiple sources – CRM, syndicated data (e.g., CIRCANA, Nielsen/NielsenIQ, IWSR), internal depletion reports, Somm.ai – into clear, concise actionable insights for sales teams and leadership.
* Monitor competitive dynamics, pricing trends, and market activity; flag meaningful shifts to the Director and relevant commercial stakeholders.
* Support category management efforts, including competitive benchmarking and account\-level opportunity analysis.
* Use market data and CRM tools to identify and prioritize high\-value target accounts and distribution whitespace opportunities at the territory and DMA level.
* Build and maintain account scoring models and target lists that help field reps focus effort on the highest\-return opportunities.
* Set goals and track execution versus goals.
* Maintain accurate records that enable timely follow\-up and measurement of targeting effectiveness.
* Prepare and maintain reporting dashboards, performance scorecards, and ad hoc analyses for sales leadership – covering depletions, POD, incentive tracking, and account performance.
* Support the annual and monthly sales planning process, including forecasting, territory analysis, KPI modeling, and planning templates that structure the team’s thinking.
* Build and improve PowerPoint and Excel tools that are designed for field use – clear, simple, and built for people who are not analysts.
* Partner with Sales, National Accounts, Demand Planning, Finance, and Growth Marketing to ensure alignment of data, insights, and commercial priorities.
* Respond to ad hoc analytical requests from sales leadership with appropriate speed and rigor – knowing when a quick answer is right and when deeper analysis is warranted.
* Maintain organized, well\-documented records of analyses and recommendations to support institutional knowledge and decision\-making continuity.
* Partner with Sales, Distributors, and Commercial Finance to develop and track against Local Marketing Fund budgets so that spends are productive and aligned to commercial priorities.
* Proactively identify opportunities to automate reporting, improve data pipelines, or reduce manual work for the sales team, including role modeling AI adoption.
* Support the adoption of new tools and data sources by building clear documentation, simple templates, and training materials where needed.

**What you will need:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Analytics, Economics, or related field preferred.
* 2–5 years of experience in data analysis, sales analytics, commercial planning, or a related quantitative role – ideally within CPG, beverage, retail, or a multi\-channel consumer business.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel – comfortable with pivot tables, complex formulas, and building analysis tools from scratch; not just maintaining existing ones.
* Proven success in adopting AI enablement to drive performance outcomes.
* Experience with at least one data visualization or BI tool (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or equivalent); ability to build dashboards that non\-analysts will actually use.
* Strong analytical thinking: able to frame a business question, identify the right data to answer it, and communicate findings clearly without over\-engineering the analysis.
* Clear, confident written and verbal communication – particularly the ability to translate data outputs into plain\-language business insights and recommendations.
* High attention to detail and strong organizational habits; comfortable managing multiple deliverables in a fast\-moving commercial environment.
* Occasional travel may be required for field engagement, trade events, or company meetings.

**What we will provide:**

* Health benefits for you and your family, including medical/dental/vision (with a competitively priced employee contribution to premium), and disability, life, and pet insurance.
* Paid time off and 11 paid holidays.
* 401(k) plan where we invest 10% of your wages every year for your retirement at no cost to you, subject to management discretion.

jobs.title: Health Coach
jobs.description:
**About Us:**



Future is building a personalized guidance system for lifelong health. We help people understand what to do next for their body, goals, and stage of life — then support them in turning those decisions into sustained behavior change. By combining AI, human expertise, personal health data, and accountability, Future helps members improve performance today while building the resilience, capacity, and healthspan they need for decades to come.

**Who We Are**
--------------



Future pairs each member with an expert coach who gets to know them, their goals, and their data, then builds a healthier life around all of it. We started in fitness, and we're now going further: a coaching\-led health experience that brings together movement, nutrition, sleep and recovery, and leverages real clinical data to build precise, custom member protocols. Our offering is continuing to evolve and we're looking for coaches who want to help shape it.


**About the Role**
------------------



As a Health Coach, you'll own a caseload of members and guide each of them from their first day through their progress milestones. This is a partner role, not a prescriber role: you draw out what a member actually wants, meet them where they are, and help them build habits that last across nutrition, movement, sleep, and stress. You'll coach through a mix of virtual face\-to\-face sessions and day\-to\-day messaging, and you'll use each member's data to make your guidance specific and personal. The members we serve expect high\-touch, polished care, with the coach at the center of their experience.


**What you'll do**
------------------


* **Own your members' experience end to end.** Guide a caseload of members from onboarding through their 90\-day milestone and beyond, and keep every one of them feeling individually known.
* **Coach live and asynchronously.** Run virtual kickoff and check\-in sessions, and support members between sessions over messaging that stays warm, timely, and clear.
* **Build personalized, data\-informed plans.** With the support of AI tooling, translate each member's goals and data into a plan across fitness, nutrition, sleep, and recovery, and adjust it as their life and results change.
* **Coach the person, not just the plan.** Use motivational interviewing and reflective listening to help members find their own reasons for change and choose their own next step, rather than handing them a prescription.
* **Make the data useful.** Under the guidance of Future’s Clinical Team, contextualize body composition scans, bloodwork and GLP\-1 considerations within your scope, and turn them into everyday actions a member can take.
* **Make progress visible.** Track progress against goals your members helped set, and celebrate the behavior and consistency wins, not just the number on a scan.
* **Help build.** Bring what you learn from members back to the team, and help us shape a program that's ever growing and evolving.

**Who you are**
---------------


* **Empathetic.** You lead with care and meet people where they are, whether it's a member having a hard week or a teammate under pressure.
* **Independent, and collaborative.** You can run your caseload at a high level without hand\-holding, and you still genuinely enjoy working alongside your teammates.
* **An active part of the community.** Even though we're a virtual company, you show up: you join calls, contribute to projects, and share honest feedback that makes the team better.
* **Proactive.** You chase down answers, follow up, and take initiative instead of waiting to be told.
* **Tech\-savvy.** You pick up new tools quickly and are comfortable working across apps, data, and platforms all day.

**What you'll need**
--------------------


**Required (non\-negotiable)**


* **A health coaching certification** from a recognized program covering behavior\-change theory, motivational interviewing, reflective listening, and foundational nutrition, such as an NBHWC\-approved program, ACE Health Coach, Precision Nutrition L1, NASM Behavior Change Specialist, or an equivalent. Full NBC\-HWC board certification isn't required, but it's a strong preference.
* **An associate's degree or higher** (or an equivalent, experience\-based path to your coaching certification).
* **2\+ years of client\-facing coaching or training experience.** Enough that you can run a member session on day one, without a ramp.
* **Proven high\-volume caseload management.** You've personally carried a large book of clients at once and kept each of them feeling individually known.
* **Comfort working with a diverse member population.** You adapt your style to meet members of different ages, backgrounds, cultures, abilities, and health starting points, and every one of them feels respected and understood.
* **Strong written communication.** Much of your coaching happens over messaging, so you're warm, clear, and personable on the page while staying professional.
* **Strong verbal communication and presence.** You also coach face\-to\-face over video, and you bring confidence, thoughtfulness and professionalism into every session.
* **Comfortable synthesizing health data.** You keep up with current health trends and have a track record of coaching clients across nutrition apps and wearable devices, bringing their data together into a single comprehensive plan.


**Strong plus (not required)**


* **A personal\-training or strength credential** (CSCS; NASM, ACE, or ACSM CPT; or similar).
* **A nutrition\-coaching certification** such as Precision Nutrition.
* **An advanced degree** in exercise science, physiology, kinesiology, or a related field.
* **Clinical collaboration in functional or integrative medicine.** You've worked alongside or under registered dietitians, nurse practitioners, or physicians.
* **Experience with luxury clientele.** You've served high\-end members in concierge medicine, a premium gym, or a private club, and you carry that polish into every inter

jobs.title: Digital Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**FIND YOUR MISSION**


Missions are accomplished with people, driving towards a greater purpose. At ClearCo, our mission is to help our 3000\+ clients achieve theirs. When talking to our own team of A players, you’ll find that it’s not only the opportunity to drive this mission forward that keeps us thriving. It’s the freedom, flexibility, and support ClearCo provides which contributes to our professional development and the pursuit of our personal missions and passions outside of work. Learn more about our state of the art, cloud\-based talent platform and why you should consider joining us here.


**Digital Operations Manager**


The Digital Operations Manager keeps ClearCompany's education infrastructure running at scale. This person turns the Product Education team's content, tools, and data into a reliable system that produces high\-quality education faster and connects learning activity to business outcomes.


The salary for this base role will be between $120,000\- $150,000 depending on experience.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* In your first 90 days, you will map ClearCompany's full education publishing workflow across the Help Center, LMS, Pendo, and in\-product learning, and build the content calendar and health\-tracking system the team runs on.
* Within 90 days, you will take ownership of the PE tech stack (Parta, Pendo, LMS, Synthesia), managing vendor relationships, user provisioning, and integration health.
* Within 6 months, you will design and launch the dashboards that connect learning activity to customer outcomes, pulling data from the LMS, Pendo, CRM, and CS platforms to give leadership a clear read on PE's impact.
* You will build and enforce the QA process that checks every piece of content against ClearCompany's writing standards before it goes live.
* You will design the internal workflows PE runs on, including content request intake, release coordination, localization handoffs, and cross\-functional review cycles.
* You will own the operational protocol for the GTM\-to\-product\-lifecycle handoff, making sure PE's involvement stays consistent and auditable at every gate.
* You will partner with the AI Knowledge Architect to maintain the hygiene of the knowledge assets powering ClearCompany's AI agents, flagging content drift and tracking which Help Center articles are indexed for retrieval.
* You will run operational due diligence whenever the team evaluates a new tool for the PE stack.
* Over your first year, you will build the operational checkpoints that keep ClearCompany's intelligence layer current as the product and content evolve together.


**WHAT WE'D LIKE YOU TO HAVE**


* 3\+ years of experience in Digital Operations, content operations, or education program management, ideally inside a SaaS company.
* Working knowledge of learning technology platforms and the ability to pull and interpret data from them.
* A track record of building processes that people actually follow because you designed them to reduce friction.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills that work across both technical and non\-technical partners.
* Experience managing vendor relationships, licensing, or tool administration.
* Comfort building dashboards or reports that connect operational data to business outcomes.
* Attention to detail that holds up under a high volume of concurrent projects and deadlines.
* Domain experience in HR tech or talent management software is a plus, not a requirement.


**WHAT YOU WILL LOVE ABOUT ClearCo**


* **The people!** Our employees and customers consistently express the best thing about ClearCo is our close\-knit, exceptionally talented team. Check out our G2 reviews to see what people are saying about our solutions.
* **A commitment to inclusion \& belonging**. Engagement \= Inclusion. Your uniqueness powers our vision of a world where organizations perform optimally with empowered managers and engaged employees. Not only will you transform how we do business, but you will be a catalyst to change the world of work for our 3,000\+ customers.
* **Outstanding benefits**. Flexible vacation, medical/dental/vision, 401k with match, and even pet insurance. We’ve got your back so you can live your best life. See the full list here.
* **It's about Listening to Many and Executing as One**: We listen to many voices then we stack hands and move forward as one team. Learn more about all our core values here
* **Professional growth**. We have promoted 24% of our team members annually compared to 11% across the industry and open new roles to our employees first.
* **Our environment!** We celebrate success and believe in transparency and teamwork to get us there. We invest in collaboration tools so you can meet with your team face to face. You can even drop in for a virtual coffee break, connect with your ClearCo mentor, or jump into a training session with our Learning Managers. Learn more here or check out our Great Places to Work Certification and Glassdoor reviews


ClearCo is an equal opportunity employer. We support and encourage diversity.

jobs.description:
### **Please be aware of recruiting scams!**


All legitimate communication from our recruitment team will come from an official calstart.org email address via email, we will not text you about a role you have not applied to or shown interest in. We will not perform any interviews via text or Zoom chat.

CALSTART does not ask for any fees or personal information such as social security numbers or bank details during the recruitment process.

**About Us**:

CALSTART is a mission\-driven industry organization focused on transportation decarbonization and clean air for all.



For over 30 years, it’s been CALSTART’s mission to develop, assess, and implement large\-scale, zero\-emission transportation solutions to mitigate climate change and support economic growth. CALSTART works with businesses, organizations, governments, and communities to create real\-life impact toward clean air and equitable access to clean transportation for all. CALSTART provides scientific, technical and policy support for regulatory development and clean technology and infrastructure acceleration.

  


### **About The Role:**



The OEMs \& Equipment Project Manager supports CALSTART's Dealer Training \& Engagement Team by managing vehicle, equipment, manufacturer, and dealer related activities across the on road and off road Voucher Incentive Programs administered by CALSTART. Reporting to the Deputy Director of Dealer Training \& Engagement, this role works closely with original equipment manufacturers, dealers, internal program teams, and government partners to coordinate vehicle and equipment additions, updates, removals, deactivations, eligibility changes, dealer affiliations, and other catalog related functions. The position helps ensure that program systems, public facing information, and internal records remain accurate, current, and aligned with program requirements.



The ideal candidate brings experience with commercial vehicles, zero emission technologies, or on and off road equipment, along with strong project management, data management, analytical, and communication skills. Daily responsibilities include tracking approval and eligibility documentation, maintaining records in Salesforce and website authoring platforms, analyzing vehicle and equipment data, preparing reports, supporting process improvements, and developing clear procedures for recurring workflows. This role will also help streamline and automate vehicle and equipment intake, year end vehicle deactivation, OEM notifications, reporting, and related administrative processes. The position offers an opportunity to work directly with emerging clean transportation technologies, build productive relationships with manufacturers and dealers, and improve the systems and processes that support transition to zero emission vehicles and equipment.


### **Duties \& Responsibilities:**


* Manage vehicle, equipment, OEM, and dealer related workflows across CALSTART administered on road and off road Voucher Incentive Programs, including additions, removals, deactivations, eligibility updates, dealer affiliations, and other program changes.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for original equipment manufacturers and participating dealers, providing clear, accurate, and timely communication regarding program processes, documentation requirements, system updates, and next steps.
* Review and track vehicle and equipment approval or eligibility documentation, coordinate required follow up, and ensure information is accurately reflected across Salesforce, public facing websites, internal tracking tools, and related program systems.
* Lead projects to standardize, streamline, and document recurring OEM and equipment workflows, including approval letter intake, catalog updates, OEM notifications, year end vehicle deactivation, and dealer or manufacturer change processes.
* Maintain and analyze vehicle, equipment, OEM, and dealer data to identify trends, monitor workflow status, support decision making, and prepare recurring or ad hoc reports for program leadership and internal partners.
* Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, process maps, templates, trackers, and training materials that improve accuracy, consistency, efficiency, and continuity across Voucher Incentive Programs.
* Partner with the Dealer Training \& Engagement Team to translate policy, equipment, and system changes into clear guidance, training resources, and communications for dealers and OEM representatives.
* Collaborate closely with Voucher Processing, Policy, Technology, Data \& Analytics, Marketing and Communications, program leadership, and government agency partners to resolve issues and ensure coordinated implementation of program changes.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual work and improve data quality through automation, system enhancements, and improved use of platforms such as Salesforce, website authoring software, Monday.com, and other program management tools.
* Support the successful launch and ongoing administration of new Voucher Incentive Programs, vehicle categories, equipment types, technologies, and program requirements by coordinating readiness activities across internal and external stakeholders.
* Manage multiple concurrent projects and time sensitive requests while maintaining organized records, clear priorities, dependable follow through, and consistent communication with stakeholders.
* Contribute to organizational goals by improving the accuracy of public facing program information, strengthening OEM and dealer relationships, reducing processing delays, and supporting the adoption of zero emission vehicles and equipment.

### **Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's degree in transportation, engineering, environmental studies, business administration, public policy, project management, data analytics, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
* At least five years of relevant experience

jobs.title: Senior Behavioral Health Training Specialist – Recovery and Community Supports
jobs.description:
**We’re excited to share an upcoming opportunity pending a contract award and are connecting with qualified candidates in advance. Once we identify the right candidate, we anticipate extending a contingent offer, with employment dependent on final award confirmation and funding.**



At Altarum, we’re driven by a simple but powerful mission: improving the health of individuals with fewer financial resources and populations underserved by the healthcare system. We partner with federal and state agencies to design and deliver solutions that make a real, measurable difference.



### **About The Role**



As the Senior Behavioral Health Training Specialist, you'll design and deliver high\-quality training and coaching to clinical and non\-clinical staff, with a primary focus on disability benefits access (SSI/SSDI) for individuals with behavioral health and physical health needs, including those with co\-occurring substance use disorders. Beyond disability benefits training, you'll also support workforce development for other behavioral health programs and initiatives, helping agencies strengthen service delivery, improve outcomes, and build lasting capacity.



You'll work closely with internal teams, community partners, and stakeholders — including the Social Security Administration, state agencies, behavioral health providers, and community organizations — to make sure training initiatives take hold and last. You'll also contribute to business development activities that help grow Altarum's training programs and expand our impact.


### **What You'll Do**


**Training Delivery and Facilitation**


* Lead trainings for clinical and non\-clinical staff on disability benefits access processes and other behavioral health programs and initiatives.
* Develop and adapt training curricula and materials using adult learning principles.
* Coach agencies and provide technical assistance to improve the quality and success rate of benefits applications.
* Evaluate training effectiveness and recommend improvements based on feedback and outcomes.


**Technical Expertise**


* Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of SSI/SSDI programs, disability determination processes, and recovery\-oriented behavioral health practices.
* Help integrate evidence\-informed practices and program evaluation findings into training content.
* Guide agencies on tracking outcomes and pursuing continuous quality improvement.
* Support business development by contributing insights and assisting with proposals as needed.


**Stakeholder Engagement**


* Partner with the Social Security Administration, state agencies, behavioral health providers, and community organizations to support the implementation and sustainability of training initiatives.
* Serve as a go\-to resource for staff and leadership on disability benefit processes and best practices.
* Engage individuals with lived experience to keep trainings person\-centered, culturally responsive, and relevant.


**Continuous Improvement and Collaboration**


* Help develop training resources, toolkits, and guides for statewide use.
* Collaborate with other trainers and project teams to share best practices and identify improvements.
* Support ongoing quality improvement and standardization of training practices across the state.
### **What You'll Bring**

* Experience delivering training, coaching, or technical assistance using adult learning principles.
* 3–7 years of experience in behavioral health, recovery supports, or related social services.
* 10\+ years of experience assisting individuals and families — including adults, children, and military veterans — with applying for SSI/SSDI and other disability benefits.
* Experience navigating Social Security's Work Incentive programs.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create clear, accessible training materials.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work collaboratively with diverse stakeholders.
* Ability to translate complex processes into practical guidance and actionable steps.
* Strong networking skills and the ability to gain buy\-in from key stakeholders.
* Willingness to travel as needed to deliver in\-person trainings.
* Experience leading a team in training, coaching, or technical assistance activities.

### **Even Better if You Bring**

**Experience or residence in the state of Michigan.**### **Why Join Our Team**


This is a role where your expertise translates directly into people getting the benefits and support they've earned. You'll shape training that reaches clinical and non\-clinical staff across multiple states, help agencies build lasting capacity, and work alongside internal teams, community partners, and individuals with lived experience to make sure that work stays person\-centered and relevant. You'll also have the chance to contribute to business development efforts that grow the reach of these training programs — extending the impact of your work even further.### **Where You'll Work**

**Remote with occasional in\-person collaboration days**


**Willing to travel up to 10–15% of the time to deliver in\-person trainings.**

If you’re near one of our offices (Silver Spring, MD, or Novi, MI), you’ll be Hybrid and will join us in person one day every other month (6 times per year) for a fun, purpose\-driven Collaboration Day. These days are filled with creative energy, meaningful connection, and team brainstorming.



Non\-local employees will join these days virtually and may be asked to join us occasionally in\-person.

### **Work Eligibility \& Requirements**


* **Candidates must be currently eligible to work in the United States; sponsorship is not available.**
* All work must be performed within the continental U.S. for the duration of employment, unless required by contract.
* Ability to work core hours aligned with Eastern Time, unless otherwise approved by your manager.
* Remote employees must maintain a dedicated, ergonomically appropriate workspac

Startup life means things shift fast. You lean into change, pivot gracefully, and genuinely enjoy figuring out what's next.


**R \- Resilient**



Building something new isn't always smooth. You bounce back stronger, see obstacles as puzzles, and never lose sight of the bigger picture.


**C \- Curious**



You ask the questions others miss. You explore for fun, not just for work \- and it shows in the quality of your thinking.

  

### **About the Role**



Zocks sells into compliance\-sensitive financial services buyers \- RIAs, IBDs, and wealth management firms \- who put every vendor through security and compliance diligence before signing. Today, that diligence work falls on individual AEs, who complete VDDQs, RFPs, and RFIs themselves on top of their deal work, with no single owner, no shared knowledge base, and no visibility into how much it's costing the business in cycle time.



The Trust \& Compliance Operations Manager owns this function end to end \- the data room, the trust center, the VDDQ/RFP response process \- turning diligence from a deal\-blocking bottleneck reps absorb into a well\-run, self\-service function that shortens sales cycles and reinforces trust with our buyers, pre\- and post\-sale.


### **What You’ll Do**


**1\. VDDQ, RFP, and RFI Ownership**


* Serve as the single point of accountability for every vendor due diligence questionnaire, RFP, and RFI that touches a deal \- new business, renewal, or expansion.
* Take response ownership off individual AEs entirely, running intake, drafting, internal review, and submission as a repeatable process.
* Track every open request to a defined SLA and flag at\-risk deals to Sales leadership before they slip.


**2\. Knowledge Base and Trust Center**


* Build and maintain a living knowledge base of pre\-approved, audit\-ready answers to recurring security, privacy, and compliance questions.
* Keep that knowledge base current with each SOC 2 cycle, policy update, or material product/infrastructure change.
* Partner with Engineering to scope and launch a self\-service trust center when the knowledge base and process are mature enough to support it.


**3\. Data Room Management**


* Own the structure and upkeep of the due diligence data room \- taxonomy, document versioning, access controls, and what's customer\-facing versus internal.
* Ensure every document in the room reflects the current state of Zocks' security and compliance posture, not a stale snapshot from the last deal.


**4\. Cross\-Functional Partnership**


* Act as the connective tissue between Security, Legal, and Product on one side and Sales/CS on the other, so sales teams get accurate, current information without chasing multiple internal owners.
* Build direct relationships with subject\-matter owners in each function to keep source information flowing without manual chasing on every request.


**5\. Reporting and Commercial Impact**


* Define and publish an SLA for DDQ/RFP turnaround, and hold the function to it.
* Report quarterly on deals unblocked or accelerated by the function, quantified in $ ARR, so leadership can see the direct commercial value of the work.

### **What We’re Looking For**


### **Requirements**


* 4\+ years experience owning VDDQs/RFPs/RFIs end to end, ideally in a regulated B2B SaaS environment
* Working knowledge of security, privacy, and compliance frameworks relevant to financial\-services vendors \- SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, GLBA/Reg S\-P, and SEC/FINRA vendor oversight expectations
* Demonstrated ability to translate technical and legal detail into plain\-English, customer\-ready language under deadline pressure
* Experience building repeatable process and structure (data room taxonomy, knowledge base, SLAs) rather than handling diligence as one\-off firefighting
* Comfortable working cross\-functionally with Security, Legal, Engineering, and Product to source accurate answers without deep technical expertise in each domain
* Experience operating directly with prospects' and customers' security, compliance, and vendor\-management teams, including on live diligence calls
* Experience in or selling to financial services, wealthtech, or another regulated industry strongly preferred, given Zocks' focus on financial advisors and wealth management firms
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

### **LOGISTICS**


* This is a remote position, but we are currently only able to hire candidates who reside in the following states: AZ, CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, ID, IL, IA, KS, MA, MI, NE, NJ, NV, NY, NC, OH, PA, SC, TN, TX, WA, WI
* Background and reference checks required as part of onboarding

  

**Interview process:**


* 30\-min recruiter screen
* Up to three 30\-45\-min video or onsite interviews
* Offer pending references.


Total estimated time: \~3 hours

  


**COMPENSATION**


* $150,000\-$175,000 base salary
* Equity \- we're all b

jobs.title: Senior Product Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Assembly Software**
Assembly Software is the team behind Neos, the case management platform purpose\-built for personal injury law firms, with embedded intelligence that already knows your cases. We're trusted by 1,100 firms and 15,000 users nationwide, backed by more than 40 years of experience in PI case management. As a growing SaaS company with a passionate team, we're building software that makes cases easier to manage and outcomes better for the firms and clients who rely on it.


When you join Assembly Software, you’re joining a team that genuinely cares about you, your career, and your excitement about your job. When you work for a tech company in the legal field, there are endless opportunities ripe for disruption, and you’ll be on the forefront of that innovation. We want you to pursue what drives you and push your boundaries! Assembly Software is where people come to shake up a historically buttoned\-up industry. **Vision Statement**
Assembly's vision is to provide the legal community the best practice management software that enables client advocacy from anywhere at anytime. **Mission Statement**
Our mission is to provide intuitive and comprehensive legal practice management solutions enhancing efficiency and profitability for our customers. **Core Values*** We are Accountable: We accept responsibility for our choices and actions. We value transparency \+ feedback.
* We Never Stop Learning: We pursue growth \+ learning.
* We Thrive as a Team: We value others' opinions \+ work respectfully with one another.
* We are Collaborative Innovators: We are adventurous, creative \+ open\-minded.
* We are Here to Be of Service to our Customer \+ our Colleagues: No matter our role, we are all here to be of service \+ add value.
* We have Unyielding Integrity: We do the right thin, even when no one is watching.
* We Embrace Diversity \+ Inclusion: We are passionate about creating and cultivating an inclusive culture that promotes and values diversity.
  

Ask five people on a product team why a launch slipped and you'll get five different partial answers: Engineering thought Product had locked scope, Product assumed Sales already knew what was changing, and Sales is finding out today, from a customer, that something they promised isn't shipping the way they described it. That gap between good people doing good work is where this job lives, and we need someone who can't stand leaving it open.


As the **Senior Product Operations Manager** at Assembly Software, you'd be the product manager for how our Product organization runs. Not a coordinator keeping a status doc updated, and not a process owner for its own sake, but someone who treats how our PMs, designers, and engineers plan, prioritize, launch, and learn as a product in itself, with real customers, real friction points, and real room to get better. You'll build the scorecards leadership can read without asking anyone for an update, run the readiness process that makes sure Sales and Customer Success know what's shipping before it ships, and use AI daily in how you actually work, not as a line in a strategy deck.


We're not hiring this role to keep the trains running on time; we already have that. We want someone who looks at how Product, Engineering, and Design work together and can't help but see exactly what's slowing them down, then goes and fixes it, whether or not it was technically their job. You'll move comfortably between a spreadsheet and a hard conversation with a VP about why a process needs to change, and you'll know when to retire your own mechanism because it's stopped earning its place.


We're fully remote, no surprise return\-to\-office memo hiding in the offer letter, with medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k), and paid parental leave. You'd be joining a small, sharp Product team that takes real pride in what it ships and is ready to hand you real ownership from day one.


If this sounds like the seat you've been waiting for, we'd love to hear from you.

 **When you’re considering a new job, it’s normal to have questions. Here are a few things we get asked all of the time:** **1\. I'm tired of the daily commute. Where are you located?**  

Assembly Software is a fully remote company. We work across time zones and connect through Teams, so you can build your career from wherever you do your best work: home office, favorite coffee shop, or yes, in your PJs if that's your vibe.

 **2\. What makes Assembly Software different?**  

Our people. We're a fast growing SaaS company and the leading provider of case management solutions for personal injury and legal firms. Through our three brands, Neos, Needles, and TrialWorks, we serve over 2,500 law firms and 40,000\+ users, the largest user base in the industry. Backed by Ridge Road Partners since 2017, we combine decades of legal tech expertise with a scrappy, entrepreneurial energy. We move fast, we care about the product, and we have fun doing it. Our sales team also enjoys uncapped commission with built in accelerators, so top performers are rewarded for their impact.

 **3\. What's the benefits package like?**  

Competitive and comprehensive. You'll have access to:

* Medical, dental, and vision plans
* Short and long term disability coverage
* Supplemental insurance options
* 401(k)
* Flexible time off
* Paid parental leave
* An Employee Assistance Program


We invest in our people because we know our results depend on them. When you do great work here, you'll be recognized and rewarded for it.

 *Assembly Software provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*

jobs.description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.  

**Senior Supply Chain Operations Manager**
------------------------------------------

**(Remote U.S. \| 50%\+ Travel to El Paso, TX)**
------------------------------------------------

We are seeking an experienced Senior Supply Chain Operations Manager to provide strategic and operational leadership for end\-to\-end supply chain operations supporting a key aerospace customer. This role is remote within the United States with an expectation of 50%\+ travel to El Paso, Texas, to support customer operations, team leadership, and business objectives.


The Senior Supply Chain Operations Manager will lead supply chain functions with a focus on operational excellence, customer satisfaction, cost optimization, talent development, and continuous improvement. This leader will play a critical role in developing scalable supply chain solutions while delivering exceptional support to customers, team members, and shareholders.


**What can you expect to do?**

* Recruit, develop, and retain top supply chain talent, including managers and key operational leaders.
* Provide coaching, mentoring, and performance management to build a high\-performing organization.
* Develop succession plans and leadership pipelines for critical roles.
* Establish clear goals, metrics, and accountability measures that drive operational excellence and employee development.

* Lead and optimize end\-to\-end supply chain operations, including:

	+ Procurement \& Sourcing
	+ Inventory Management
	+ Logistics \& Transportation
	+ Warehousing \& Distribution
	+ Supplier Management
	+ Materials Management
* Drive operational performance through KPI management, trend analysis, forecasting, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Partner closely with customer stakeholders to ensure service, quality, delivery, and cost objectives are achieved.
* Support business growth through scalable processes, systems, and operational best practices.

### **Financial \& Cost Management**

* Identify opportunities to reduce costs and improve operational efficiency.
* Drive productivity improvements through process optimization, automation, and elimination of non\-value\-added activities.
* Develop and manage forecasts related to resources, capacity, inventory, and operational requirements.
* Monitor departmental expenses and operational performance to achieve financial objectives.

### **Customer \& Cross\-Functional Leadership**

* Serve as a trusted partner to a key aerospace customer, ensuring exceptional service and responsiveness.
* Collaborate with global Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Quality, Finance, and other functional teams to achieve business goals.
* Communicate strategy, performance, risks, and improvement opportunities to senior leadership.
* Act as an escalation point for operational and customer\-related challenges.

**What is the experience needed to be successful in this role?**
----------------------------------------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree required in Supply Chain, Operations, Business, Engineering, or a related field.
* 12\+ years of progressive supply chain experience across all major supply chain functions, including planning, procurement, logistics, transportation, warehousing, inventory management, supplier management, and materials operations.
* 4\+ years of people management experience leading managers, supervisors, and/or large operational teams.
* Demonstrated success leading supply chain operations within a manufacturing environment.
* Experience managing customer relationships and delivering high levels of customer satisfaction.
* Ability to travel 50% or more to support operations and customer activities in El Paso, TX.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting aerospace and defense customers and regulated manufacturing environments.
* Bilingual English/Spanish skills strongly preferred.
* Experience managing cross\-border supply chain operations between the United States and Mexico, including transportation, customs, trade compliance, and material flow optimization.

**Benefits Package with Jabil**

Along with growth, stability, and the opportunity to be challenged, Jabil offers a competitive benefits package that includes:


* Competitive Base Salary

* Medical, Dental, Prescription Drug, and Vision Insurance with HRA and HSA options

* Commuter Benefits

* Annual Merit Increases
* Community Volunteer Opportunities

jobs.title: Remote Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking an experienced and business minded Remote Operations Manager to own client relationships and design workflow for a growing luxury outdoor design firm. In this pivotal role, you will manage the full post\-sale client experience for outdoor contractors, pool builders, and general contractors — onboarding new clients, capturing design and revision requests, and routing work to our design team with speed and precision. Every client you speak with is a business owner running their own company, so a business\-minded approach and in field experience matter as much as design knowledge. You will hold real decision authority over scope, deadlines, and assignments, and you will build the systems this role runs on from the ground up. This is an exciting opportunity for a landscape professional who enjoys constant client contact, makes fast decisions, and wants to shape a position rather than inherit one.

**Duties**

* Own the client relationship for monthly member accounts.
* Onboard every new client following sale close, including the initial call, expectation setting, and orientation to our design process.
* Capture new design requests and revision requests through any channel the client prefers — email, phone, text, or video walkthrough — and document them in specific, actionable terms for the design team.
* Assign design and revision work to the senior lead designer or junior project manager the same business day, and set the corresponding deadline.
* Adjust deadlines and reallocate work between designers as capacity requires, in coordination with the senior lead designer.
* Conduct proactive check\-ins to identify client frustration before it becomes churn, and drive retention across the assigned account base.
* Convert trial clients into monthly members following completion of their trial designs, and re\-sign seasonally paused members each spring.
* Review completed designs for accuracy and buildability prior to client delivery, as capacity allows.
* Document the systems and processes of this role in written form sufficient for a future hire to follow.

**Required Skills**

* Hands\-on outdoor construction or design experience — field installation, design, or both. You will be discussing grading, drainage, hardscape, plant material, and what will actually build on site. Contractors can tell within minutes whether you have done this work.
* Business\-minded approach with the credibility to speak owner to owner. Our clients run contracting businesses, and they respond to someone who understands margin, job timelines, crew scheduling, and what wins them work.
* Fast, confident decision\-making under incomplete information, particularly on scope and prioritization. A request sitting unassigned overnight is a failure of this role.
* Exceptional attention to detail translating verbal client requests into written or drawn design direction. A misread note costs a designer a day and costs us a client's trust.
* Genuine enjoyment of high\-volume client contact with busy, direct professionals. This is the majority of the job, not an interruption to it.
* Strong verbal and written communication across phone, text, email, and video calls.

**Preferred Skills**

* Familiarity with reading or producing 3D renders and 2D construction plans.
* Ability to direct and coordinate work through colleagues who do not report to you.
* Comfort building processes, checklists, and documentation from scratch with no existing template.
* Proficiency with project management and CRM tools, or demonstrated ability to learn and configure them quickly.
* Prior account management, client success, or project management experience in a service business.

Join us as a Remote Operations Manager if you're ready to own client relationships end to end, make the calls that keep projects moving, and build the playbook the next person will follow.

Pay: $3,000\.00 \- $4,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance

Work Location: Remote

**Reports To:** Senior O\&M Specialist**Location:** Hybrid or Remote**Salary Range:** $82,000 to $106,000
* ***This position is eligible for the annual performance bonus plan.***


This position primarily involves working remotely or in an office.

Final determination of a successful candidate’s starting pay will vary based on a number of factors, including market location and may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, education and experience. The pay scale listed for this position is generally for candidates that meet the specified qualifications and requirements listed on this specific job description. We provide a competitive compensation package that recognizes your experience, credentials, and education alongside a robust benefits program to meet your needs. Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets.**WHO WE ARE**  

Since 1954, Cupertino Electric, Inc. (CEI)has been powered by people who’ve built a reputation for delivering high\-profile, complex projects. Real, tangible things that alter the landscape and improve lives. And we've done it with integrity for more than 70 years. We’re problem solvers and innovation seekers. We’re team players and safety fanatics. And we're proud to be part of Quanta Services (PWR:NYSE), North America's largest employer of skilled craft labor. Because what we do is important, but how we do it is everything.
**THE ENERGY TEAM**
Our Energy Group at CEI builds projects from the field to the grid. Whether it’s a solar, battery storage, substation, EV charging, microgrid or converter station project, our skilled project managers, engineers and field employees deliver when it matters most. We work with customers on programs of all sizes—those spanning several smaller sites or spanning several thousand acres. Besides building some of the nation’s largest utility\-scale solar plants and installing more EV charging stations in California than any other contractor, we are dedicated to running a business that is environmentally responsible.
**ABOUT THE ROLE**
At Cupertino Electric, **Assistant Project Managers (APM)** are key to coordination between the field team, project team, and our customers. By partnering with the Project Manager, the APM will learn the processes and witness the critical thinking required for approaching our projects from a strategic lens. The APM will gain a deep understanding of CEI’s scope of work on a project. Additionally, they contribute to, review, and track project activities including change orders, submittals, tracking logs, and related project documents.
* Lead team meetings and provide guidance to Project Engineers and Project Coordinators in partnership with the Project Manager, Production Manager, field team and Trade Partners.
* Identifies cost and schedule impacts associated with RFIs, submittals, and design changes and provides timely notification.
* Prices change orders consistently and in a timely manner for project manager review and approval.
* Develops and manages close out documents as the Project progresses.
* Coordinate commissioning activities w/ 3rd party. Tracks and follows up on open items.
* Maintain strong working partnerships with vendors and subcontractors. Coordinates accurate material releases on time and consistent with project documents. Track material releases, changes and coordinate delivery with construction schedule.

**ABOUT YOU*** Serve as the go\-to person to help resolve any issues or potential problem areas.
* Actively thinks about new ways to improve or change processes. Brings innovative and entrepreneurial thinking to a project.
* Prior experience working on semi\-remote jobsites, supervising others. Renewables/Large Electrical/Data Center build experience highly desired.
* Good working knowledge of MS applications including Excel.
* Prior experience in electrical estimating and the ability to accurately estimate change order pricing.
* Knowledge of Electrical Code and Civil Construction.

**WHAT YOU WILL GAIN**
As an Assistant Project Manager (APM) at Cupertino Electric, you will be empowered to learn the skills and competencies required to become a successful Project Manager. APMs have the opportunity to execute Project Manager level activities within the safety of the larger Project Team. This is when all of the deep, technical, and process\-guided learning comes into play. Partnered with a Project Manager, through practice and feedback, you will learn the processes, and witness the critical thinking required for strategic project approach, which will in turn set you up for a successful future on your career path. You will be interacting extensively with the CEI Production Team, customers, and vendor and subcontractor partners, giving you opportunities to cultivate relationships and build your professional network.
**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS***Any combination of education and experience that, in the sole judgment and discretion of Company, would likely provide the required knowledge, skills and abilities as well as possession of any required licenses or certifications may qualify.***Education:** High School Diploma or GED required. Bachelor’s Degree in Construction Management, Business, Engineering, or similar preferred.
**Licensure/Certifications:** None required.
**Experience:** Three (3\) or more years of experience specifically as a Project Engineer in electrical construction (Renewable Energy preferred) or MEP/Civil/Structural experience in general contracting. Minimum five (5\)\+ years of related experience, including some time managing smaller projects.

**Driving Record:** Valid state\-issued driver’s license and satisfactory driving record.

* Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for sponsorship.

Overview:

LMI is seeking a skilled ServiceNow Implementation Specialist for a Federal DoW client. This is a fully remote position. A successful ServiceNow Implementation Specialist will demonstrate competency in ServiceNow, requirements analysis, critical thinking, and business growth while upholding the highest standard of ethical behavior.
LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial\-grade platforms and mission\-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.


Leveraging our mission\-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.


Responsibilities:
* Deliver the full implementation life cycle to support the deployment of ServiceNow modules into complex client environments
* Work with Agile teams and methodologies in a virtual environment.
* Develop a good understanding of the customer’s ServiceNow business needs.
* Coordinate with client stakeholders to understand the mission needs of the client and implement those requirements in ServiceNow
* Provide technical expertise on all technical questions related to assigned implementation on the ServiceNow platform.
* Deliver in progress and final capability demonstrations of ServiceNow implementation to client stakeholders
* Implement ServiceNow modules for multiple customers.
* Implement configurations and customizations for multiple customers.
* Create and manage workspaces, business rules, UI actions, workflows, reports, dashboards, and user portals.


Qualifications:

Required Experience

* Undergraduate degree required. Degree in engineering, finance, economics, operations research, mathematics, or a related discipline preferred.
* This position requires six (6\) or more years’ work experience.
* Four (4\) or more years’ experience in configuration and implementation of the ServiceNow platform or applications.
* Demonstrated experience in implementation and deployment of ServiceNow modules using Agile DevSecOps techniques in a client environment
* Demonstrated experience with ServiceNow platform capabilities in a client environment
* Demonstrated experience with the ServiceNow Business Rules and the scripting aspects of the ServiceNow Platform.
* Experience in ServiceNow application implementation and deployment
* Some travel may be required within CONUS only


Desired Experience

* Experience implementing ServiceNow within a Human Centered Design framework
* Demonstrated experience in configuring and customizing ServiceNow Service Portal pages and widgets
* Demonstrated experience in configuring and customizing ServiceNow Workspaces.
* Demonstrated experience with the implementation of ServiceNow in Customer Service Management (CSM) and one additional module: Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) domain, Human Resources Service Delivery (HRSD) or Integrated Risk Management.
* Demonstrated experience implementing ServiceNow modules to clients in the US Federal Government


Desired Certifications

* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator
* ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist \- CSM

  

Target salary range: $76,000 \- $130,000\.  

The salary range displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is not a guarantee of compensation. Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to location, internal equity, business considerations, client contract requirements, and candidate qualifications, such as education, experience, skills, and security clearances.

The program spans the implementation, integration, and ongoing sustainment of the eNativeTrust platform and the next\-generation Electronic Probate System (EPS), delivered within a secure Microsoft Azure Government (FedRAMP Moderate) cloud environment to improve services for American Indian and Alaska Native communities nationwide.

You will lead cross\-functional Agile teams delivering cloud services, mobile applications, data transformation pipelines, and automated workflows using modern Microsoft technologies and DevSecOps practices, while serving as a primary liaison between the project team, client stakeholders, and agency leadership.

Demonstrated experience as a Scrum Master, Project Manager, Operations Manager, or hybrid role in enterprise IT environments, ideally within federal programs.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
About Meridian:

Meridian Bioscience is a fully integrated life science company that develops, manufactures, markets and distributes a broad range of innovative diagnostic products. We are dedicated to developing and delivering better solutions that give answers with speed, accuracy and simplicity that are redefining the possibilities of life from discovery to diagnosis. We are looking for talented and passionate individuals who help drive our vision. Our innovative culture will allow interested candidates to discover and create, through collaboration, cutting\-edge solutions to tough problems.
Job Summary:

The Project Manager leads cross\-functional new product development projects for in vitro diagnostic (IVD) assays and diagnostic instrument systems in an FDA\-regulated medical device environment. This role is accountable for project planning and execution from concept through launch, with emphasis on design control compliance, schedule, risk, resources, budget, and clear decision\-making. The Project Manager partners with R\&D, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Clinical Affairs, Operations, Marketing, and external development partners to achieve business and product objectives. The position may be based locally in Cincinnati or performed remotely, with travel as required to support project teams and key milestones.
Key Duties:
* Partner with R\&D, Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Clinical Affairs, Finance, and Marketing and others to define project scope, goals and deliverables as well as successfully manage projects
* Develops accurate, achievable project plans and timeline, consistently communicating the plans with team members and the leadership team
* Drives team ownership and commitment to project plans and recommends changes when necessary to meet project outputs
* Tracks and communicates project performance, specifically to analyze successful completion of short\- and long\-term goals
* Ensures on\-time completion of tasks as required by the project and/or company procedures
* Facilitates cross\-functional project team meetings
* Other duties as assigned


Qualifications:
* Bachelor’s degree in science, engineering or business administration or related field required; advanced degree preferred.
* At least 5 years of project management experience leading cross\-functional product development projects.
* Direct experience managing FDA\-regulated medical device product development projects.
* Working knowledge of medical device design control requirements and product development processes, including design planning, design reviews, risk
* Preferred: Experience with in vitro diagnostic (IVD) products, including assay and/or diagnostic instrument development.
* Preferred: Experience working within Quality Management Systems compliant with FDA 21 CFR Part 820 and applicable medical device regulations.
* Preferred: Project management qualification (PMP) or equivalent.
* Demonstrated Project Management skills with proven record of practical project management experience preferably in the diagnostic or related biotechnical field
* Demonstrate successful management of product(s) from concept to launch
* Must have the ability to perform critical path identification
* Excellent problem\-solving skills. Must be a self\-starter, detail oriented and able to prioritize and balance workloads and timelines and ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously
* Must be able to work independently as well as collaboratively with peers and colleagues in a cross functional setting
* Must be well organized and have the ability to meet strict deadlines and perform under pressure in a fast\-paced work environment
* Excellent interpersonal, organizational and written and oral communication skills
* Basic understanding of device development, engineering, and manufacturing activities is a plus
* 20% travel

jobs.description:
**Work Location:** Remote  

**Hours per week:** Part\-Time position, 5\-20 Hours  

**Pay:** $18\.00 \- $20\.00 per hour  

  

**Agency Description**  

At Big Brothers Big Sisters of Eastern Massachusetts (BBBSEM) we believe that every child deserves to have a mentor in their corner and to ignite and defend their potential. That's why **we are committed to promoting the healthy development of children through the nurturing of continuing, one\-to\-one friendships with caring responsible adults**, supported by trained professional staff. To accomplish this we partner with schools, workplaces, and volunteers all over Eastern Massachusetts to bring our program and services closest to youth who need them.  

  

**Role Summary**  

As a Volunteer Enrollment Specialist you will play a unique and essential role in the creation of our Big/Little relationships. You will conduct thorough interviews with interested volunteers that will help us learn more about those interested in our agency, and share insights to interested volunteers. Following each interview you will write quality assessments that will help us determine the fit of each candidate. **This is a key part of our the placement or “matching” process for prospective volunteers and youth/families**.  

  

**Schedule \& Location*** During the initial two\-week training and onboarding period, we require a commitment of 20 hours per week. Upon completion of onboarding, this role will be expected to maintain a set schedule and be available for up to 15 billable hours per week. Actual hours may range from 5 to 15 per week based on interview volume and scheduling needs.
* This is a fully remote position (work from home), so candidates will be expected to have a reliable internet connection to complete their work.

**Key Responsibilities*** Assess volunteers through virtual interviews
* Document clearly and in a timely manner all information obtained through the assessment and matching process and maintain accurate records for volunteers and families.
* Carefully and thoughtfully coach interested volunteers in order to make them ready to participate in our program.
* Partner with enrollment coordinators to share information and help facilitate the matching process
* Advocate for volunteers seeking placement who may not be immediately ready and maintain regular communication to ensure the most up\-to\-date information when placement options become available.
* Constantly look after the safety of our youth and inform management of any critical information and/or potential issues that may impact our services.
* Be a part of a true team \- together with your peers work on projects and events that will drive enhancements and improvements

**Basic Qualifications*** Bachelor’s degree with one or more years of applicable work experience, associate's degree with 2\+ years of relevant work experience, or High school diploma/GED with 7\+ years of relevant work experience
* Availability to work part\-time. Hours will include evenings
* Access to reliable internet and phone connections to perform work remotely
* Familiarity with Office 365 (excel, word, PowerPoint, etc.)

**Desired Qualifications*** Ability to work nights (until 8pm EST) and on some weekends
* Excellent writing and documentation skills
* Demonstrated comfort and ability to work with and motivate a wide variety of people, including youth and adults, with a preference for candidates with experience in racially, ethnically, and socio\-economically diverse urban and/or recent immigrant communities
* Ability to successfully work independently and in a team environment
* Enthusiasm, creativity, a positive sense of humor, and a “can\-do” attitude
* Proven organization and time management skills to complete a high volume of varied responsibilities in a fast\-paced setting
* Knowledge of Salesforce, Office 365 suite

**About Diversified:**  

Diversified is a global leader in audiovisual and media technology. We design and build innovative spaces and experiences for clients across industries such as corporate, entertainment, sports, retail, and government. Our team partners with organizations around the world to create environments that connect people through technology.
  
  

**What to Expect:**  

At Diversified, you’ll work on exciting and complex projects with opportunities to grow your career. We offer a collaborative and flexible work environment, competitive pay and benefits, and a culture that values diversity, inclusion, and innovation. If you’re ready to grow, create, and make an impact, Diversified is the place to do it.
  
  

Job Summary
  
The Senior Project Coordinator (Sr. PC) is an integral member of the project team responsible for organizing, controlling, executing, and facilitating project activities. The Sr. Project Coordinator supports the logistics, planning, coordination, and project finances throughout the project lifecycle. Sr. Project Coordinators will work with the Sales and Technical Operations teams and will assist with project kick\-offs, equipment ordering/tracking, through project closeout procedures. This includes, but not limited to, creating project documents, coordinating vendors, tracking procurement, scheduling and attending project meetings, as well as other project related tasks. The Sr. Project Coordinator works closely with the Project Management and Technical Operations Teams to ensure project success.
  
Primary Duties and Responsibilities
  
* Review project conversions and budgets to confirm that they align with customer purchase orders and contracts. Coordinates with sales and PM to resolve issues.
* Provides efficient, accurate, and effective administrative support to the Tech Ops
* department.
* Provides general administrative support for Project Teams and local management,
* depending on office location.
* Assists the project team in staying current and compliant with Diversified policies,
* procedures, and standards.
* Coordinates with designated AR staff to initiate regular project billings per contract
* requirements and established billing rules. Including AIA billing documents if applicable.
* Provides project support mainly during the Initiating, Purchasing, and Closing Project Phases but is involved in the entire project lifecycle.
* Assist in posting all critical project documentation on enterprise document management portals.
* Is the primary interface between the PM and the Procurement Group.
* Assist in the management of the Bill of Materials (BoM) for active projects.
* Works with Shipping \& Receiving to help coordinate project deliveries.
* Coordinate onsite deliveries, inventory, and other onsite tasks as needed.
* Attends training classes as required by the needs of the department and assigned by management.


DAILY
  
  

* Provide administrative support for Project Managers regarding equipment ordering,
* tracking and documentation. Facilitate subcontractor/vendor quote approvals.
* Check on equipment delivery status for active projects and follow up with order entry on
* any unreceived or unpurchased items from POs, etc.


WEEKLY
  
  

* Attend project meetings, internal and external.
* Review and prepare billing submittals for AR.
* Review Project financials.


MONTHLY
  
  

* Organize monthly Cost reports for active projects.
* Review and prepare billing submittals for AR.
* Project closeout checklist tasks.
* Reproduce needed forms for project preparation.


Education \& Certifications
  
* High School Diploma or equivalent
* AVIXA CTS or Industry Certifications


Competencies, Skills and Experiences
  
Required
  
* 5\+ years of experience in a Project Coordinator support role and/or projects\-related role.
* Experience with MS Office suite of software products with an emphasis on Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint plus Adobe skills.
* Familiarity with Accounting Systems.
* Experience with Project management software, such as MS Project required.
* Ability and willingness to mentor other team members.
* Empowered to act on behalf of PM when necessary.
* Must be able to perform work duties in a team\-oriented environment as well as remote locations.
* Effectively communicate both orally and written, relevant project information to the project team.
* Ability to adapt to shifting priorities seamlessly.
* Manage daily demands and timelines through analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Reacts to project adjustments and alterations promptly and efficiently.
* Skills to elicit cooperation from a wide variety of sources and all departments within the company.
* Well organized with the ability to rapidly switch tasks.
* Adept at conducting research into project\-related issues and products.
* Ability to prioritize and execute tasks in a high\-pressure environment is crucial.


Desired
  
  

* Technical/business degree or equivalent work experience preferred.
* Microsoft Teams
* Dynamics 365
* General Contractor, Construction, Security, Integration background
* Familiarity with AIA, Prevailing Wage, documents, and process
* Client management skills
* Strong financial acumen


Decision Making Authority
  
The Sr. PC is responsible for providing project support for Project Managers. They should work collaboratively with their project teams and supervisor to manage bandwidth and tasks. The Sr. PC will always get direction from the PM’s and management on any difficult or unusual situations.

The physical demands described here are representative of those that may be met by an employee. **Account Manager Associate – CarepathRx**


Join CarepathRx as an Account Manager Associate, where you will support patients, caregivers, referral sources, and Account Managers throughout the infusion and specialty pharmacy service process. In this role, you will help confirm insurance coverage, coordinate required documentation, communicate financial responsibilities, and support timely transitions to home\-based care.

**Responsibilities**

* Support the Account Management team with customer and patient service needs across Infusion and Specialty Pharmacy programs.
* Complete insurance verification activities and document coverage details accurately in the patient management system.
* Enter and maintain patient demographics, services, payer information, and other required records.
* Obtain insurance authorizations and precertifications required for specialty or infusion services.
