**Operational Excellence**

* Keep CRM records accurate and current, including renewal timelines, stakeholder maps, health scores, risk flags, and engagement recaps
* Share account patterns and insights with your team and AE partners to build collective knowledge of what works across your segment
* Act as the connective tissue for your account: bring in Solution Success, Product Success, Data Management, and Support at the right moment, so specialist engagement feels seamless to the customer

**What You'll Need**

Minimum Qualifications


* 6\+ years in B2B SaaS Customer Success, Account Management, or Consulting

Preferred Qualifications


* A track record of retaining and growing multi\-stakeholder enterprise accounts across multiple renewal cycles

new_jobs.description:
**About Crossover Health**


Crossover Health is creating the future of health as it should be. A national, team\-based medical group with a focus on wellbeing and prevention that extends beyond traditional sick care, the company delivers an entirely new model of healthcare—Primary Health—built on the foundation of trusted relationships, an interdisciplinary care team approach, and outcomes\-based payment. Crossover’s Primary Health model integrates primary care, physical medicine, mental health, health coaching, care navigation and more, and delivers care in surround\-sound—in\-person, virtually and via asynchronous messaging. Together we are building a community of members that embraces healthcare as a proactive part of their lifestyle.

**Job Summary**

 **Job Responsibilities**


The Virtual Care navigator plays a key part in delivering an exceptional member service experience. As an integral member of our Virtual Care team, the Virtual Care Navigator works closely with providers and staff to ensure an exceptional seamless patient\-centered care experience. The role requires a collaborative mindset, flexibility, and a willingness to take on key tasks to ensure the smooth operation of the virtual clinic, along with a strong commitment to delivering high\-quality patient care and outcomes.

new_jobs.title: Closing Operations Associate
new_jobs.description:
**About the team**
------------------

The Coordinator II, Transactions, Closing Operations supports a high volume of real estate transactions by coordinating closing activities, validating documentation, and resolving routine post\-closing issues to ensure accurate, compliant, and timely completion of files. This role collaborates closely with internal partners and external stakeholders to track status, address discrepancies, and maintain organized records that support a seamless experience for customers and business teams.
**About the role**
------------------

Zillow Closing is looking for an experienced Closing Operations Associate to join our growing national team and help deliver exceptional, technology\-enabled closing experiences for buyers, sellers, and their agents. In this role, you will manage a pipeline of purchase and refinance transactions in a high\-volume, fast\-paced environment, partnering closely with internal teams and external partners to ensure smooth, on\-time closings. Your ability to solve problems within evolving workflows and collaborate with cross\-functional teams will directly shape how we scale and improve our escrow operations across the country.  

  



**You Will Get To**
-------------------

* Provide exceptional customer service across phone, email, SMS, and chat for customers and transaction partners, ensuring clear, timely communication throughout the closing process.
* Manage a real estate closing pipeline with other Operations teams to drive smooth, accurate, and on\-time closings for buyers and sellers.
* Build strong relationships with assigned brokerages and agents and support outreach efforts from our growth team, including participating in client meetings as needed.
* Review multi\-state purchase contracts and ensure compliance with contractual, legal, and regulatory requirements and deadlines across national and local jurisdictions.
* Deliver a “local” experience by understanding and meeting local market expectations, customs, and practices while leveraging Zillow Closing’s national reach.
* Identify and explain title issues and requirements from searches and title commitments, and guide transaction parties through the steps needed to resolve them.
* Calculate and prepare closing fees (including recording fees, title charges, taxes, HOA dues, payoffs, and related items), prepare accurate disbursements, and collaborate with lenders to balance Closing Disclosures and prepare complete loan and closing document packages that meet client, county, and state requirements.
* Work cross\-functionally with exam, curative, funding, and post\-closing teams; adapt to evolving workflows and platform enhancements; provide clear feedback to product and engineering teams; work across multiple applications; and maintain accountability to service standards and performance metrics in Zillow’s Cloud HQ environment.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.
In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $25\.00 \- $37\.40 hourly. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $23\.70 \- $35\.50 hourly. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.
In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.
**Who you are**
---------------

* 2\+ years of experience in closing operations, real estate transactions, mortgage operations, or a related high\-volume, documentation\-focused operations environment.
* You have experience in title and escrow closing, ideally with purchase transactions across multiple states, and are comfortable working to define service standards and key performance indicators.
* You bring a strong customer service orientation, putting buyers’, sellers’, agents’, and lenders’ experiences first in every interaction.
* You are comfortable using a variety of technologies and workflow tools, especially those that support managing phone and email communication in a high\-volume environment.
* You have a proven ability to prioritize competing deadlines, manage multiple transactions at once, and deliver high\-quality work in a fast\-paced setting.
* You communicate clearly and effectively with customers and internal partners and bring strong attention to detail, including the ability to learn and follow county, state, and regulatory requirements.
* You bring a forward\-thinking, problem\-solving mindset and enjoy partnering with technical teams on discovery, testing, and feedback for new product enhancements and features.
* You are team\-oriented and collaborative across functions, are willing to obtain state escrow licensing where required, and see bilingual skills—particularly Spanish—as a plus if you have them.
* Here at Zillow \- we value the experience and perspective of candidates with non\-traditional backgrounds. We encourage you to apply if you have transferable skills or related experiences.

**Get to know us**
------------------

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most\-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing
